description: Crowdsourcing experiments with participants recruited on CrowdFlower in February 2018, choosing pairs of options under story constraints, produced systems of responses that Contextuality-by-Default classifies as truly contextual.
limitations: Respondents could not choose combinations that broke the instructions, and the design was chosen for modeling simplicity.

sources.quote: We recruited 6192 participants on CrowdFlower (2018) between February 7 and 12, 2018
